scope: M10A isolated boundary observations; no product import admission, hardware qualification, quantitative budget or gate acceptance

method.isolation: Fresh browser process and non-persistent context per fixture/repeat; sequential attempts; no OS/disk cache purge.
method.bootstrap: Enter the existing route and load its default textured fixture, disable animation, unload, then settle two requestAnimationFrame callbacks.
method.firstTarget: First target load in this context after bootstrap: renderer/module/image-decoder state already warmed. This is not fully cold application/model loading.
method.firstRender: Adapter firstRenderMs measures CPU setup and render submission plus error checking, without a GPU completion fence.
method.repeatedTarget: Immediate reload of the same target in the same context. HTTP cache remains disabled by Playwright resource-closure routing for both loads.
method.frames: Raw requestAnimationFrame intervals and nearest-rank sample percentiles; not CPU/GPU render duration. Orbit/transform use the existing scripted adapter probe, not native pointer input.
method.percentiles: Small per-attempt samples are retained without tail-confidence claims; with 60 samples nearest-rank p99 is the maximum observed interval.
method.memory: JS heap is a browser estimate if exposed, with no forced GC. Manifest decoded/mipmap byte estimates and observed typed-array bytes do not measure GPU/process memory.
method.resourceClosure: HTTP requests restricted to built local files. Pinned GLB responses are independently hashed; loader-owned blob URL count must return to zero.
method.budgetVerdict: not evaluated; no numeric performance budget is asserted

nodes-1000.provenance: Self-authored project geometry and checker pixels, derived from the original fixed spike recipe; no external source asset.

measurement.recipe: 1000 total nodes including one root; 999 direct mesh children reference one cube mesh, one material and one shared geometry allocation.
measurement.estimateNote: Analytical RGBA8 image/mip estimates and shared source geometry bytes only; not measured native/GPU memory or a complete session accounting policy. Geometry is shared, not counted once per node.
